body:
A registered launcher run selected with --request-message-id needs an original native message that (1) the LAUNCHING session RECEIVED as its recipient and (2) carries a TYPED testRequest. Send it with CLI `mailbox send --test-request-json '{"mode":"full","targets":[{"workRef":"w-…","use":{"kind":"committed_input","expected_commit":"<commit40>","purpose":"landing_gate"}}]}'` or as the MCP send's testRequest object (docs/features/agent-mailboxes.md). Plain prose is not a request: 409 "selected message has no host-owned typed test request". The runner's own outbound message is refused with 409 "selected test request belongs to another native recipient or sender".
CREDIT ASSOCIATION IS CAPTURED FROM THE SENDER (Fable2 #7807; mailbox_test_request_custody.rs:209-264): the SENDER must hold a current claim on each target workRef, with a unique named source root. A scheduler such as Opus2 that holds no claim on the items must NOT send typed requests for them. Every target then carries uncreditedReason "association_stale: target has no unique current held claim and named root", which can never credit. Only the claim holder issues the request; Engram::Fable has the Engram-side recipe. After any typed send, read it back (`mailbox read-message --message-id ID --json`) and check that no target has an uncreditedReason.
A run refused at admission ran no stage, so it is not a gate result, and one corrected launch is not a rerun of a passed gate. Seen 2026-11-25 on Merger bfa9d8ac: test-d900f09a, test-00166572, and stale requests 93013530 and 574d9a08.
